body:
## Purpose

Set 18 default parameters of the global P-model land model (`toml/default_parameters.toml`) from a recalibration against ERA5 turbulent fluxes and upwelling longwave radiation and GOSIF GPP, on the model of #1907 (SurfaceFluxes 1.5, sub-canopy reference height, stems in the canopy radiation, spatially varying canopy height/SAI/RAI, 0.25° MODIS LAI).

## Content

- New values for 16 parameters already in `default_parameters.toml`, and entries for `maximum_dry_soil_layer_depth` and `soil_scalar_roughness_length`, which previously came from ClimaParams.
- Descriptions of these parameters say they are calibrated. Descriptions that justified the old values are corrected: the derivation of `leaf_Cd`, the acclimation timescale of `pmodel_α`, the woody-plant stem reflectances, and the canopy height below which `canopy_subcanopy_min_reference_height` binds.
- A NEWS entry.
- `test_canopy_helpers.jl` checks the new defaults of the sub-canopy wind extinction and minimum reference height.

No model code changes. The calibration config is not included.

## Calibration

- **Method:** EnsembleKalmanProcesses `TransformUnscented` (UKI), with 17 parameters and an ensemble of 35. The PAR and NIR stem reflectances are tied by one common scale factor.
- **Targets:** seasonal means of ERA5 LHF, SHF and LWU and of GOSIF GPP, with prescribed 0.25° MODIS LAI.
- **Period:** 16 yearly samples (Dec 2003 – Nov 2019), taken in 2-year minibatches with a 1-year spin-up.
- **Run:** 9 iterations, with no failed members out of 315.
- **Misfit:** fell from 0.110 to 0.073 on the 2003–04 minibatch, the only one scored both at the first and at the last iteration.

The calibration ran on the head of #1907 before it was merged (d0a5a3c37). Main has since added #1923, which handles absent canopies and some edge cases more robustly, and #1909, which changes plots only. The verification run was not repeated on top of #1923.

| parameter | old | new | prior bounds | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pmodel_cstar` | 0.366 | 0.463 | 0.2 – 0.7 | |
| `pmodel_β_c3` | 24.9 | 112 | 2 – 300 | |
| `pmodel_β_c4` | 8.89 | 1.76 | 1 – 100 | near lower bound |
| `pmodel_α` | 0.0251 | 0.0113 | 0.005 – 0.33 | acclimation timescale ≈ 88 days; prior mean 1/14 |
| `moisture_stress_c` | 0.591 | 0.759 | 0.05 – 1 | |
| `leaf_Cd` | 0.07 | 1.17 | 0 – ∞ | |
| `canopy_z_0m_coeff` | 0.0823 | 3.26e-6 | 0 – 0.5 | at lower bound |
| `canopy_z_0b_coeff` | 0.073 | 0.00157 | 0 – 0.5 | at lower bound |
| `canopy_z_0min` | 0.01 | 0.0257 | 1e-4 – 0.3 | |
| `canopy_K_lw` | 1.16 | 0.999 | 0 – 2 | |
| `SAI_coeff` | 0.16 | 0.158 | 0 – 1 | |
| `RAI_coeff` | 1.0 | 0.22 | 0.05 – 5 | |
| `stem_PAR_reflectance` | 0.16 | 0.32 | scale 0.25 – 2 | scale at upper bound (2.0) |
| `stem_NIR_reflectance` | 0.39 | 0.78 | scale 0.25 – 2 | scale at upper bound (2.0) |
| `canopy_subcanopy_wind_extinction_coefficient` | 0.5 | 0.0556 | 0.05 – 2 | at lower bound |
| `canopy_subcanopy_min_reference_height` | 0.5 | 2.86 | 0.5 – 3 | near upper bound |
| `maximum_dry_soil_layer_depth` | 0.015 | 0.00296 | 1e-4 – 0.1 | ClimaParams default before |
| `soil_scalar_roughness_length` | 0.007 | 0.00302 | 1e-5 – 0.1 | ClimaParams default before |

## Verification

A global run with the old defaults and one with the new values: Dec 2016 – Dec 2019, ERA5 forcing, prescribed MODIS LAI. Both are scored over Dec 2017 – Nov 2019, after a 1-year spin-up. The table gives the latitude-weighted RMSE of the annual mean, with the bias of the seasonal means in parentheses.

| variable | old defaults | new values |
|---|---|---|
| LHF (W m⁻²) | 16.18 (−4.1) | 11.35 (−0.1) |
| SHF (W m⁻²) | 16.49 (+7.5) | 10.91 (+0.1) |
| LWU (W m⁻²) | 4.62 (+1.9) | 4.00 (+1.3) |
| GPP (g C m⁻² day⁻¹) | 1.205 (+0.34) | 1.132 (−0.10) |

In vegetated cells, the LHF bias goes from −6.8 to −0.7 W m⁻² and the SHF bias from +10.3 to +0.04 W m⁻².

## Caveats

- **Six parameters end on or near a prior bound:**
  - both canopy roughness coefficients;
  - the sub-canopy wind extinction;
  - the stem reflectance scale;
  - the sub-canopy minimum reference height;
  - `pmodel_β_c4`.

  The prior ranges limit the fit.
- **Canopy roughness is the same at every height.** It is about `canopy_z_0min` = 0.026 m for any canopy, against 1.66 m for a 20 m forest with the old defaults. The scalar roughness length is larger than the momentum one, by a factor of 2.2 at 20 m. The fit likely compensates for the old sensible heat excess through roughness rather than finding physical values.
- **`leaf_Cd` is not well constrained.** At 1.17, it is 17× the laminar boundary layer estimate, and it trades off with the roughness coefficients and the stem reflectance scale.
- **Stem reflectances are twice the woody-plant values.** The NIR reflectance is 0.78.
- **Acclimation is slower than the prior.** The P-model timescale is about 88 days, against a prior mean of 14 days.
- **The verification period is short.** It is two years.

## Testing

- `create_toml_dict` returns all 18 values.
- A first local run of the vegetation tests failed only on the two default-value asserts in `test_canopy_helpers.jl`, now updated. A full local run of the vegetation, soil-parameter and integrated land-model tests is in progress.
